prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were consistently too high across all tests compared to noise-corrected measurements.
new_flow changes (in adoption and home) are helpful, as both produced confirmed winning tests.
finish, redesign and sign_in, reorder have been tested twice each, showing no positive effect or worsening performance.
Evidence remains thin for all other specific kinds of changes because each has only been tested once so far.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +3.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, copy: +0.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, hint: -3.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: -5.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +1.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: -2.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, new_flow: +0.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: -0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, incentive: -3.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -1.6% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 63.3%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 85.5%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.5%

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Pre-Generation Pet Mood Selector Flow: Inserts a mood configuration step before adoption certificate to customize companion personality traits. Users pick their preferred initial companion temperament. (why: Adoption has a low conversion (63.3%) and users report custom pets looking wrong or failing. Adding interactive customization in adoption aligns with successful new_flow tests.)
1: [home, new_flow] Desktop Placement Loader Flow: Adds a desktop boundary calibration flow while waiting for desktop pet spawn. Ensures desktop assets render properly before entering main screen. (why: Home waiting step has a long mean duration of 2336s and 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on screen. New_flow changes in home are proven winners.)
2: [adoption, new_screen] Companion Trait Preview Screen: Introduces a trait review screen before completing adoption certificate so users can review created attributes. (why: Support receives tickets regarding custom pets looking wrong, and adoption step drops off heavily at 63.3%.)
3: [choose_path, new_screen] Onboarding Path Overview Screen: Adds an intro screen before path selection that clearly contrasts standard preset pet adoption with custom photo creation. (why: Choose path takes a mean 514s indicating user hesitation during initial path selection.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Story & Path Carousel Layout: Converts the choose_path screen to a carousel layout displaying visual path previews side-by-side. (why: Median time on choose_path is 8s but mean is 514s, showing a long tail of stalled users.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Spawn Readiness Status: Displays animated progress details and estimated setup duration during the waiting background step. (why: Home stage waiting screen has the largest delay (2336s mean), leading users to close app before spawn finishes.)
6: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Account Persistence Callout: Adds an informative hint explaining that signing in links pet state securely so data is preserved on re-login. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
7: [finish, notification] Post-Setup Companion Desktop Arrival Alert: Enables push notification readiness alert and tray instructions on home intro screen when pet setup completes. (why: 3 support tickets reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to locate or interact with the desktop pet.)
8: [sign_in, layout] Streamlined Sign-In Options Layout: Changes sign_in layout to compact format to minimize layout stalls and simplify sign in interaction. (why: 2 support tickets reported sign-in screen stalling or failing to load, and sign_in step conversion is 72.9%.)
